+def test_sdk_metadata(assets, props, targets, admission, project, policy):
+    """Only the pinned Test.Sdk net8.0 producer, not a general package-source evaluator."""
+    require(str(project) in admission['contexts'].values(), 'Project has no pinned Test.Sdk entrypoint admission')
+    require(policy['GenerateProgramFile'] == 'true' and policy['GeneratedProgramFile'] == admission['files']['source']['path']
+            and policy['NuGetPackageRoot'] in admission['package_folders'] and policy['Language'] == 'C#',
+            'Actual Test.Sdk entrypoint generation policy differs')
+    require(assets['project']['restore']['projectPath'] == str(project), 'Test.Sdk assets belong to another project')
+    key = admission['package_key']
+    library = assets['libraries'][key]
+    require(library['type'] == 'package' and library['path'] == admission['package_path'] and
+            library['sha512'] == admission['package_content_hash'], 'Test.Sdk resolved package identity differs')
+    relative = {role: str(Path(admission['files'][role]['path']).relative_to(admission['package_root']))
+                for role in ('source', 'producer', 'props')}
+    require(set(relative.values()) <= set(library['files']) and
+            set(assets['targets']['net10.0'][key]['build']) == {relative['producer'], relative['props']} and
+            assets['packageFolders'] == admission['package_folders'], 'Test.Sdk resolved source/build assets differ')
+    ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/developer/msbuild/2003'}
+    for text, role in ((props, 'props'), (targets, 'producer')):
+        expected = '$(NuGetPackageRoot)' + admission['package_path'] + '/' + relative[role]
+        tree = ET.fromstring(text)
+        imports = tree.findall('.//m:Import', ns)
+        matches = [node for node in imports if node.attrib.get('Project') == expected]
+        require(len(matches) == 1 and matches[0].attrib.get('Condition') == "Exists('" + expected + "')" and
+                any(matches[0] in list(group) and group.attrib.get('Condition') == " '$(ExcludeRestorePackageImports)' != 'true' "
+                    for group in tree.findall('m:ImportGroup', ns)), 'Test.Sdk actual NuGet import producer differs')
+
+
+def package_entrypoint(k, policy):
+    admission_path = HERE / 'package-entrypoint-admission.json'
+    admission = json.loads(admission_path.read_bytes())
+    if str(k.PROJECT) not in admission['contexts'].values():
+        return None
+    require(all(Path(row['path']).resolve() == Path(row['path']) for row in admission['files'].values()),
+            'Redirected pinned Test.Sdk package input')
+    k.verify(list(admission['files'].values()))
+    assets_path = Path(policy['Assets'])
+    require(assets_path == k.PROJECT.parent / 'obj/project.assets.json', 'Unexpected Test.Sdk assets location')
+    assets = json.loads(assets_path.read_bytes())
+    props = assets_path.parent / (k.PROJECT.name + '.nuget.g.props')
+    targets = assets_path.parent / (k.PROJECT.name + '.nuget.g.targets')
+    test_sdk_metadata(assets, props.read_text(), targets.read_text(), admission, k.PROJECT, policy)
+    inputs = [k.identity(path) for path in (admission_path, props, targets)] + list(admission['files'].values())
+    return dict(package=admission['package_key'], source=admission['files']['source'], producer=admission['files']['producer'],
+                inputs=inputs, assets=k.identity(assets_path),
+                effective_policy={name: policy[name] for name in ('GenerateProgramFile', 'GeneratedProgramFile', 'NuGetPackageRoot', 'Language')},
+                scope='Exact pinned package source required in both before Compile items and executed Csc arguments; no assembly execution.')
